setting.group: cyclic group of odd order n
setting.coefficients: any field or module where 2 is invertible

theorems.cyclic_shift_span: span{T^j f : 0<=j<n} is the complete n-dimensional function space
theorems.explicit_inverse: the shifted-parity circulant C satisfies C^{-1}=(I+T)/2
theorems.stable_module_boundary: every T-invariant linear subspace containing f has dimension n

closed_classes: poly(log n)-dimensional linear function spaces containing exact parity and invariant under Q -> Q+G
bounded-dimensional linear translation recurrences generating exact parity
not_closed: representations not invariant under Q -> Q+G
short arithmetic circuits outside one small linear translation module
impact_on_hpcx: refutes the most direct linear stable-module proof strategy but does not decide general H-PCX or H-RPCX
